introduction_markdown: General Certificate of Education (GCE) Board, Ordinary Level, June 2021. Additional Mathematics, Paper 2 (code 0575). Time allowed: two and a half hours. Answer ALL questions in SECTION A (Pure Mathematics, compulsory) and ANY TWO questions from EITHER SECTION B (Mechanics) or SECTION C (Statistics and Probability). In Sections B and C, all questions carry equal marks. Candidates are expected to answer a combination of Section A and Section B OR Section A and Section C, but NOT a combination of all three. If Section B is chosen, Section C may not be chosen, and the other way round. All necessary working must be shown. No marks will be awarded for answers without brief statements showing how the answers have been obtained. Electronic calculators may be used. Where necessary take g as 10 m s^-2. Formulae booklets may be used.
enonce_intro_markdown:
The marks scored by 100 students in an examination are distributed as follows:

| Marks ($x$) | 1-5 | 6-10 | 11-15 | 16-20 | 21-25 | 26-30 | 31-35 | 36-40 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Number of students ($f$) | 8 | 10 | 12 | 20 | 23 | 12 | 9 | 6 |
incertitudes: Regles de choix : la consigne imprimee est « Section A obligatoire, puis DEUX questions de la Section B OU DEUX de la Section C, jamais un melange des trois ». Le systeme ne sait exprimer que « 2 parmi 3 » par section ; l'exclusivite B ou C est recopiee dans introduction_markdown mais n'est pas appliquee par les regles_choix.

Points : le sujet imprime des points par sous-question, pas de total par question. Le champ points de chaque exercice est la somme des points imprimes des sous-questions (Section A : 8 ou 9 ; Sections B et C : 17, ce qui est coherent avec « all questions carry equal marks »).

Q12 : le graphique (a) est a tracer par le candidat. Mediane et ecart semi-interquartile sont des lectures sur graphique ; les valeurs donnees (20,5 ; 13,4 et 26,3 ; 6,46) viennent d'une interpolation lineaire sur les frontieres de classes 0,5 a 40,5. Si le candidat trace aux limites superieures (5, 10, ...), les lectures different d'environ 0,5.

questions.enonce_markdown: (a) Draw a cumulative frequency graph of the distribution. *[5 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The marks are whole numbers, so the class boundaries are $0.5,\ 5.5,\ 10.5,\ 15.5,\ 20.5,\ 25.5,\ 30.5,\ 35.5,\ 40.5$. Plot each cumulative frequency against the **upper class boundary**:

| Upper boundary | 0.5 | 5.5 | 10.5 | 15.5 | 20.5 | 25.5 | 30.5 | 35.5 | 40.5 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cumulative frequency | 0 | 8 | 18 | 30 | 50 | 73 | 85 | 94 | 100 |

Scales: for example 1 cm for 5 marks on the horizontal axis and 1 cm for 10 students on the vertical axis. Plot the 9 points and join them with a smooth S-shaped curve (an ogive) from $(0.5,0)$ to $(40.5,100)$.

questions.enonce_markdown: (b) From your graph, estimate the median. *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The median is the value at cumulative frequency $\dfrac{100}{2}=50$. On the graph, the horizontal line at $50$ meets the curve at $x=20.5$.

**Median $\approx20.5$.** (A reading of 20 or 21 from a hand-drawn graph is acceptable.)

questions.enonce_markdown: (c) From your graph, estimate the semi-interquartile range. *[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Lower quartile $Q_1$: cumulative frequency $25$. It lies in the class $10.5$ to $15.5$ (cumulative $18$ to $30$): $Q_1\approx10.5+\dfrac{25-18}{12}\times5\approx13.4$.

Upper quartile $Q_3$: cumulative frequency $75$. It lies in the class $25.5$ to $30.5$ (cumulative $73$ to $85$): $Q_3\approx25.5+\dfrac{75-73}{12}\times5\approx26.3$.

Semi-interquartile range $=\dfrac{Q_3-Q_1}{2}=\dfrac{26.33-13.42}{2}\approx6.46$.

**Semi-interquartile range $\approx6.5$** (graph readings give values close to this).
